messages:
emma_sales: Heads-up — Acme Retail POC ready to move to activation but Legal put a hold. They require EU-only processing + BYO-KMS and want a final list of subprocessors, routing policy details, and the delta in pricing if they take a Dedicated EU pool vs hosted. Who can own responses? 

owen_se: I can own the technical answers. Quick Q: do they need per-tenant pinning (sticky routing) or is region-prefer + failover ok?

emma_sales: Customer insists on tenant pinning to EU region for data-in-flight and storage. Failover allowed to adjacent EU region only, never global.

infra-bot: Inventory snapshot (auto): subprocessors_eu.csv uploaded: https://s3.redwood/internal/subprocessors/subprocessors_eu_2026-03-12.csv :paperclip:

owen_se: Thanks infra-bot. Tala, can you confirm: BYO-KMS routing path looks like this in our config, right?

Tala_Solutions: Confirm. Example policy we use for EU-pinned tenants: 
```
routing_policy:
  mode: pinned
  primary_region: europe-west1
  allowed_failover_regions: [europe-west2, europe-central1]
  kms: byok-required
```

Tala_Solutions: Note: BYO-KMS requires KMS endpoint connectivity from the EU serving nodes to the customer's key endpoint or a partner HSM connector. That dependency is on the customer OPS side and may require a peering/VPN.

mike_sec: From security side: we need a completed security questionnaire and confirmation of BYO-KMS key usage policy (wrap/unwrap patterns). Also need attestation that the customer's KMS provider meets our minimum FIPS/HSM requirements. I can draft a short checklist.

legal_bob: Legal needs the subprocessors CSV plus a mapping that shows which subprocessors see plaintext vs encrypted metadata. Also need confirmation on data egress controls and a clause we can offer for EU-only processing.

owen_se: Action items I see: 1) infra to confirm subproc list and data access levels (infra-bot provided CSV). 2) SE to document routing_policy and network dependencies (I will). 3) Security to provide BYO-KMS checklist (mike_sec). 4) Sales/legal pricing delta for Dedicated EU pool.

emma_sales: Pricing ask from customer: what's the monthly premium for a Dedicated EU pool sized for ~200 concurrent sessions and 20M tokens/mo? Finance, can we get a fast delta?

emma_sales: Also, risk blocker: customer wants activation within 3 weeks, but Ops warns KMS peering + subproc attestation may take longer. We need to align timeline in the next 48h.

tala_solutions: I can sketch the network dependencies for peering + expected ops lead time: typically 2-4 weeks if customer provides firewall rules and contacts. If they need an air-gapped transfer to HSM, add 2 more weeks.

mike_sec: Draft BYO-KMS checklist: 
- KMS provider name and support contract
- Key wrap/unwrap API endpoints (w/region)
- FIPS/HSM certs
- Access control lists for Redwood service principal
- Rotation policy
I will upload the checklist here when done.

infra-bot: Reference docs: subprocessors page: https://redwood.internal/docs/subprocessors ; eu-region-capacity-terms: https://redwood.internal/pricing/dedicated-eu ; routing-runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/routing-failover

nowen_se: For the thread: I'll produce a short one-pager for Legal that includes the routing snippet, specifics on which subprocessors have KMS access (none; only metadata processors), and the estimated ops timeline. Expect draft in ~6 hours.

emma_sales: Perfect. I'll update the customer: will send an ETA for the 48h alignment and note potential 2-4wops on peering. @legal_bob @mike_sec @tala_solutions please ping here when your pieces are uploaded. :thumbsup:

legal_bob: Will review infra CSV once SE confirms which subprocessors see plaintext.

mike_sec: Uploading BYO-KMS checklist to the thread in ~2h.

emma_sales: Thanks team — if we can get the price delta by EOD we can keep the activation target. Otherwise, push to next sprint.

infra-bot: Ticket created: PRESALES-8427 — attach subprocessors CSV and ops timeline. Link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/PRESALES-8427

emma_sales: noted. Closing loop for now, will post customer update after SE draft.
